limitations: Silvermoon Turbo is absent from the live model catalog; both arms instead use Anima base with matched 30-step CFG4 normal sampling settings.

One run per arm, in fixed order. Filesystem and kernel warmup may affect timing despite cleared model/executor caches. The 2.517-second difference does not establish a stable speed improvement.
